displayName: Field Corn — Pioneer P1257AM (RR2 + YGCB, dent)
notes: Standard Mid-Atlantic dent corn. Roundup Ready 2 + YieldGard CB (corn borer) traited. 110 d maturity fits Loudoun County. Phase 11 trait override: halex-gt + roundup-powermax-3 are tolerated thanks to the RR2 trait.
